notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Boratium Wars 0.26.36a

Alien Bandits have arrived.

Non-lethal at the moment, but quick to steal resources.
Dispatch them quickly for a handsome reward!

They are unaffected by collisions and do not take damage from concussions or explosions triggered from chain reactions. Only a direct shot from your weapon can destroy them, otherwise they will wonder and collect until they get their fill.

Added particle effects and recalculated sector planet visuals.

Enjoy!

Increased weapon damage for higher level weapons.

Added 2 more shield upgrades.

Auto Deployed shields with 50% longer duration than previous sheilds

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Boratium Wars 0.26.30a

Added the talent "Phase Shift" to the ship "Bilalicus".

This allows the player to phase out of the dimension, making them immune to all damage for 1 second.

Note: No collection of any kind is possible during the phase shift.

To use the Talent, press TAB or Q, or click the LB on the controllers.
There is a 2 second cool down between phase shifts.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Boratium Wars 0.26.29a

Released ship #8 the "Stutok P8"

The is the first ship with a special ability.
It can Hyper Jump.

The is done by pressing "Q" or the LB on the controller.

The Ship will dematerialize and jump in the direction the ship is facing when triggered.

The distance between the two jump points is not crossed, but rather folded.
Objects in the path are missed since the ship never actually goes through the area of space.

Its very useful for getting places quickly, or out of a bad situation, and adds a whole new element to job.

Enjoy and good luck!

notes.content:
Boratium Wars 0.26.25a


Added a 500 Boratium Token award for every Early Access Alpha game owner until the sale ends Oct 27th.

We need more players to test the new ships and rack up the leader boards.

Thanks for joining us on this ride and enjoy!

To collect your award, simply launch the game while logged in on Steam and you should see a deposit of 500 Tokens to your account as soon as the lobby is loaded.

This is a one time award and linked to your steam account.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Boratium Wars 0.26.18a

Added Steam persistent inventory support, to store player owned ships and tokens with their steam account instead of locally with the game files. This enables players to recover asset's owned in the event of any loss or damage of the game files.

Added penalties based on sector difficulty for player ships lost in a match.

Added image compression to reduce files sizes and game load times.

Added full support for Achievements and Stats
Currently there are 12 Achievements to unlock.


Boratium Wars 0.26.08a Patch Notes

Added full support for Leaderboards.

There is one primary leader board for Any Ship and one secondary leader board per player ship type. 

So every game played lands on the leader boards somewhere, but only your best score per steam account, will be visible on the leader boards.
